corrections.text: The article says the "67–89% less CPU while your server sleeps" section "contains only an image, so no methodology or baseline could be read," and that the idle-CPU claim "has no readable detail in the text of the release notes." The image's alt text in Bun's post does give detail: the comparison is against v1.4.2, measured after a 30-second load test with one health check every 10 seconds, on Linux x64, with CPU time over two idle minutes listed per framework (for example Express 282 ms on v1.4.2 against 57 ms on v1.4.3). These figures are Bun's and were not independently replicated.
